description: Station panel → regular lon/lat grid for UniST (T×C×H×W).
aggregation: mean of stations whose lon/lat fall in the cell
empty_cells: NaN in raw; filled with 0.0 for model tensor; occupied mask saved
notes: H+W < 32 keeps UniST on its smallest batch_size path
D1 IDW/Kriging baselines stay on original station points; grid is for UniST only
Cross-scene: build bthsa and yrd with the same H×W and variable set
